memberdef.name: XSecure_RsaPrivateDecrypt

briefdescription.para: This function sends IPI request to Perform RSA decryption with private key.

parameterdescription.para: Address of the data which has to be decrypted
Key size in bytes, Input size also should be same as key size mentioned. Inputs supported are XSECURE_RSA_4096_KEY_SIZE, XSECURE_RSA_2048_KEY_SIZE, or XSECURE_RSA_3072_KEY_SIZE
Address of the buffer where resultant decrypted data to be stored

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS If the update is successful
XST_INVALID_PARAM On invalid input parameter
XST_FAILURE If there is a failure
Return XST_INVALID_PARAM if InstancePtr or its MailboxPtr is NULL
Return XST_INVALID_PARAM if Size is a unsupported RSA key size
Link shared memory of size RsaParams to RsaParams structure for IPI usage. Validates the size of the shared memory whether the required size is available or not.
Fill Payload
Send request to PLM through generic request API. This internally handles SMC or IPI mailbox based on build configuration.
